title: Law to require police training on restraining pregnant people
summary: This bill would require the NYPD to train officers on laws and policies limiting the use of physical restraints on people in custody who are pregnant or postpartum. Starting January 30, 2027 and annually for five years after, the department must publish a report on training delivery and the number of officers trained or not yet trained. The law would take effect 30 days after being signed.
